artworks.title: L'Hiver à Paris (Winter in Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, spit-bite etching, soft-ground etching, drypoint, and scraping in black on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling urban scene in 1879 Paris during winter. The tall buildings on either side of the street lead the eye into the distance where more architecture merges with the cloudy sky. The brushstrokes show fine details of buildings and snow on the ground. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of gray and black. In the foreground, dogs play in the snow, and figures in winter attire move about. In the background, horse-drawn carriages line the snow-covered street as pedestrians navigate the scene. Small vignette-like illustrations to the left show various aspects of city life during winter.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, stop-out and roulette on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a slightly elevated point of view looking down a thoroughfare to the left. The horizon line is near the center of the drawing, aligning with the rooftops of the buildings. Carriages are parked along the street, receding toward the vanishing point on the left side. Smoke rises from chimneys, contributing to the urban atmosphere. The style features fine linework creating a textured scene, resembling a sketch or etching. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray for depth and contrast, and wet streets reflect the surroundings. Figures walk with umbrellas while carriages line the street, suggesting rain. Farther away, more carriages follow the curve of the street, disappearing behind buildings.

artworks.title: L'Église de Jobourg
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a building, possibly a church, on the left side with a pointed roof against a light sky. The horizon line is high, giving more space to the sky with sparse clouds. There are figures walking on a dirt path leading to the building. The color palette is muted with shades of beige and black dominating. Brush strokes create a textured effect, giving a rustic and serene quality to the landscape.

artworks.title: La Falaise: Baie de Saint-Malo (The Cliff: Saint-Malo Bay)
artworks.medium: heliogravure, etching, drypoint, roulette, and spit bite, aquatint, and burnsihing in black (central plate) and gray-green (margin plate) on heavy wove light green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path leading to a water body. The horizon is higher in the composition with silhouettes meeting the water and sky. The sky has textured clouds. The brushstrokes seem detailed, capturing variations in the landscape and sky. The color palette is mostly gray. There is dense vegetation and a hill in the foreground. The border of the image has decorative motifs.

artworks.title: La Fête nationale au Boulevard Clichy (National Holiday on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, stop-out, foul-bite, and soft-ground etching in black ink (main subject) and in brownish-black ink (margin illustrations)on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street in a late 19th-century setting. Various people, including men in top hats and women in long dresses, are walking or standing alongside the sidewalk. There are individuals pushing a cart, a small dog and cat, and street lamps visible. In the background, there are tall buildings with flags, indicating a festive atmosphere, potentially for a national holiday. The sky has expressive clouds. The surrounding sketches show additional scenes, including horses, figures, and decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Zigzags d'un Curieux, d'Octave Uzanne"
artworks.medium: etching in black on beige japan paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cover and surrounding illustrations for a publication titled "Zigzags d'un Curieux." The drawing features intricate line work depicting a central illustration framed by an elaborate border filled with various figures, creatures, and decorative elements. The central panel shows an individual at a table reading, an owl nearby, and bats flying overhead. Below this scene, a small horse and various botanical and fantasy motifs decorate the border. The top features stylized text of the title and the author's name, Octave Uzanne. The composition is detailed and dense with visual information, suggesting themes of curiosity, intellect, and a touch of the fantastical, with its variety of diverse visual symbols and motifs.

artworks.title: The Marine Painter (Le Peintre de Marine)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, stop-out, sandpaper ground, and spit bite in blue-black and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This image features a silhouetted figure walking on a shoreline. The viewpoint is low, looking slightly upwards. The horizon divides the intense sky and sea. The dark, expressive etchings create textures in the sky and water. Birds fly across the sky, adding movement. The ground has textured lines suggesting seaweed and water ripples. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks and grays. Cross-hatching adds to the moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Spleen et Idéal
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and foul bite in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage on a pathway. The image is rendered in a style with intense crosshatching and dense, dark lines to depict texture and movement. The foreground shows a horse pulling the carriage, with the horse's head positioned downward. The carriage is depicted at a slightly elevated angle, with intricate hatch marks creating depth and shadow. The background is shaded heavily, filled with dynamic lines suggesting a turbulent sky. Strong contrasts between light and dark are used to add drama to the scene.

artworks.title: Marine: Souvenir of Medway
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nautical scene with wooden structures near the water. A figure is seated by the structures, looking towards the sea. In the distance, a large sailing ship is seen against the horizon. The sea is calm, and the sky has swirling clouds painted in sepia and brown tones. Other boats and a distant structure or lighthouse can be seen.

artworks.title: The Passage
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and soft-ground etching in brown (main subject) and in black (margin illustrations) on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of scenes on a ship under stormy weather. The image is composed of multiple vignettes depicting various activities and scenes occurring on a ship. Central to the composition is a detailed illustration of a ship deck with figures using umbrellas against the wind and rain. To the sides, there are smaller scenes, such as silhouetted figures against a stormy sea, and groups of people huddled under cover or engaged in different activities possibly related to music and rest. The top shows a series of sailboats battling rough waters under a brooding sky. Each vignette uniquely captures the somber mood of a stormy sea voyage, showcasing different perspectives and moments aboard the vessel.

artworks.title: L'Angélus
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from a level point of view, with tall structures and trees blocking the horizon. On the left stands a building with ornate roof edges. The image showcases dense and expressive brushstrokes creating a textured effect that highlights shadow and light. The overall color palette is monochromatic sepia. A figure is walking along a muddy path with an umbrella and lantern. Other faint figures are visible ahead, framed by trees with bare branches.

artworks.title: Matinée d'Hiver sur les Quais
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and sand paper ground onlaid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene with buildings stretching across the horizon. Smoke billows from chimneys against a sepia-toned sky. The textured etching style emphasizes a gritty atmosphere. Figures are seen on the wet street, with carriages and streetlamps adding to the city setting.

artworks.title: Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, soft-ground etching, and roulette in brownish-black ink on wove paper, backed with thin tissue
artworks.description: The image shows a city scene with a view from a slightly elevated angle. Big Ben is at the center of the bustling urban landscape. Various architectural elements, including the London clock tower, fill the horizon. The etching technique is detailed, with brushstrokes capturing movement and intricacy in the clouds and street activity. The color palette is mainly sepia, giving the image an old-fashioned feel. The foreground features horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians, while the background shows a dense urban skyline. The margins are decorated with sketches, adding to the complexity of the image.

artworks.title: La Place des Martyrs et la Taverne du Bagne
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, lift-ground aquatint, drypoint, roulette, and burnishing in brown-black on turpentine soaked paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a night scene in an urban environment. The image shows a crowded square or street with a large building displaying the sign "TAVERNE DU BAGNE" illuminated on its facade. Surrounding the building are various other structures depicted with dark shading to convey the nighttime setting. Several figures are gathered in front of the building, suggesting an event or gathering. The drawing includes trees with bare branches, implying a season other than summer. The image is bordered with detailed sketches and handwritten text, adding to a historical or storytelling element. The play of light and shadow creates a dramatic scene, emphasizing the urban landscape and the people present.

artworks.title: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a street scene with dogs and an archway. The image portrays a night-time setting with a cobblestone street, where the shadows of canine figures can be seen illuminated by light. The central figure is a large, shrouded silhouette. In the background, an archway opens into darkness. The use of lines and shadows contributes to a mood.

artworks.title: Woman at Toilette
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 20.3 x 25.4 cm (8 x 10 in.)
page size: 35 x 48 cm (13 3/4 x 18 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ken and Kiyo Hitch in memory of Harry Lunn, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on the floor in a room. She is wrapped in a garment, her shoulder is partially exposed. Her hair is styled in a bun with an accessory. She is looking at her reflection in a round mirror on a stand in front of her. She is wearing a light-colored checkered kimono. In front of her is a box with items and a teapot on a small stove. The floor has a woven texture and the backdrop is a plain curtain or wall.

artworks.title: Les Programmes du Théâtre Libre
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Cafritz Foundation in memory of Martin Atlas
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with distinctive facial features, long white hair and beard, standing inside a wooden structure. The man wears a dark brown jacket and striped pants, and is depicted reaching forward with his left hand while the right hand rests at his side. In the background, there is text in French in an ornate font that reads "Les Programmes du Théâtre Libre" and "Silhouette d’Antoine dans les Tisserands." The overall color scheme of the image is muted and earthy, with a cream-colored background.

artworks.title: L'Arlequin
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical cabaret program. The image features a harlequin figure dressed in a classic diamond-patterned costume, complete with a ruffled collar and mask, sitting on a wooden stool. The figure is depicted gesturing with one hand and smiling. The title "L'Arlequin" is prominently displayed at the top in bold, stylized letters. The text provides information about the location "3 Rue D'Arras" and includes the phrase "L'Arlequin Cabaret Artistique De La Rive Gauche." The word "PROGRAMME" is written vertically in red letters on the right side of the image. This is in the style of Toulouse-Lautrec, capturing the belle époque era's vibrant cabaret scene with its expressive line work and emphasis on theatrical promotion.

artworks.title: Ton Sang
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration with two figures embracing each other closely. The figures are depicted from the waist up, intertwined in a swirling movement with dynamic, curved lines surrounding them. Their facial features are gently rendered, with one figure having short dark hair and facing downward, while the other figure, with slightly longer and lighter hair, tilts their head upwards. The figures are dressed in simple, subtle-toned clothing that blends into the sketch's monochromatic style. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background merges into the composition with sweeping lines, contributing to the dreamlike ambiance of the scene. On the left side of the image, there is text in French detailing a theatrical performance titled "Ton Sang," with names of performance participants and the venue's address. The name "Henry Bataille" appears inscribed towards the bottom right of the illustration.

artworks.title: Père
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on japan paper (deluxe edition impression)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Cafritz Foundation in memory of Martin Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical event announcement. The composition is a detailed poster highlighting a gala evening featuring a play by August Strindberg, with accompanying text in an ornamental, artistic style. The poster announces a theatrical performance and lists the distribution of roles alongside decorative elements. It includes illustrations of figures reading a book at a desk and possibly sleeping figures in the lower left corner, surrounded by swirling lines. The artistic lettering and the inclusion of both text and illustrative figures suggest an Art Nouveau influence.

artworks.title: Les Oeufs de Pâques
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof of early state without letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an oversized egg with bird hatchlings emerging from it. The drawing features a large, elliptical egg at the center, with the top cracked open to reveal a cluster of bird hatchlings. Surrounding the egg are various elements including an inkwell with a quill pen and illustrations on paper indicating a writing or artistic theme. The background contains faintly sketched scenes and flying birds.

artworks.title: Arches of the Larger Baths at Hadrian's Villa
artworks.medium: black chalk and white chalk with stumping on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin with arches and crumbling stonework surrounded by overgrown vegetation. The horizon is slightly elevated, emphasizing the towering remnants of the architecture. Expressive brushstrokes and textures are notable, especially in the vines and leaves on the stone. The color palette is subdued, mainly earthy tones and black, creating contrast and suggesting openings into the distance, enhancing the old, abandoned feel of the ruins.

artworks.title: March and April
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with figures engaging in agricultural activities such as pruning vines and tending plants. A bare tree dominates the left side, with figures working on a small hill to the left. In the center, a building sits on an incline leading into a wooded area. Animals are present. On the right, grand buildings are seen on a hill. A rainbow appears in the sky. The scene is rendered in crosshatched lines, portraying a detailed and textured appearance.

artworks.title: May and June
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving depicting a scene from an aerial view. It shows a landscape with a horizon in the middle distance, separating the sky with clouds and celestial symbols. On the left, there is a grand building surrounded by terraces with urns and figures. Some figures are strolling or conversing. In the foreground, people in period clothing are gathered for a performance or storytelling. Nearby, a person plays an instrument near a lion's head fountain. Further right, a boat with passengers and rowers navigates a river toward a building where additional figures are visible. The engraving is finely detailed, capturing textures of foliage, stone, and water. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grayscale.
